messages:
sam_engineering: Heads up — pushing hotfix v2026.3 to staging now. This fixes the auth token expiry that was causing 5xx on embeddings. Need an expedited prod window at 21:30 UTC, pinging @kevin_oncall for approval.

deploy-bot: /deploy staging started (sha: abc1234). Smoke and integration tests queued.

maria_ops: can we do a small canary (5%) then ramp? also suggest pinning v2026.2 as a fallback image.

kevin_oncall: Oncall is +1 for a fast window if staging tests pass. please share ETA for staging results.

deploy-bot: staging smoke tests passed ✅. latency and auth traces look normal. canary job ready.

sam_engineering: Canary on staging looks clean for token regen traces. Plan: deploy to prod at 21:30 UTC (in ~15m). Rollback criteria: >2% 5xx or token_error spike >10% over baseline.

nina_prodmgmt: Release notes snippet prepared, CS notified draft ready. I approve the expedited window — go ahead as long as oncall signs off.

kevin_oncall: Approving expedited window. Set a 30m change window and hold manual rollback pin. Tagging @maria_ops to monitor dashboards.

maria_ops: Monitoring dashboard up, alert thresholds configured (5xx >2%, token_error >10%). I'll hold the rollback pin and stand by.

deploy-bot: PROD deploy scheduled by @sam_engineering for 21:30 UTC. Canary: 5% for 5m, auto-stop on threshold breach. Notifications to #eng-oncall.

sam_engineering: Rolling now. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/llm-inference`

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% traffic -> v2026.3.

sam_engineering: Canary metrics look clean so far, no error uptick.

kevin_oncall: Green from my side, proceed to 50%.

deploy-bot: Ramping canary to 50% (ETA ~3m).

maria_ops: Small blip at 21:34 — token_error rate +1.2% (within threshold). continuing to monitor.

sam_engineering: Noted. continuing rollout, pushing to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: v2026.3 serving 100% traffic.

nina_prodmgmt: Release notes posted: "Hotfix v2026.3 — fixes token expiry causing embed 5xx. Users should see immediate improvement. If issues occur, we will rollback to v2026.2." PR: https://git.redwood.example/release-notes/2026.3

sam_engineering: Closing out from deploy side. Rollback plan (manual pin by Maria): `kubectl set image deploy/llm-inference container=service:v2026.2` — Maria has pin and will trigger if alert thresholds breach. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
